# LifeOS (lifeos)
Area, active

A private journal that answers questions about your own life

The journal is the product. Everything else here serves it: the apps, the brand and the server.

Entries stay encrypted on the device.

Paths: home note Areas/lifeos/README.md, design Areas/lifeos/design.md
Repos: example/lifeos

## Goals
- A hundred people pay for it
- Every answer cites the entry it came from
- Goal codes: Q1
